joy-1-optimistic.emotionalAlgebra: Optimistic sits at the border of Joy and Anticipation, combining happiness with forward-looking energy. It's the feeling of seeing bright possibilities ahead.

joy-2-confident.emotionalAlgebra: Confident is pure Joy energy directed inward—a recognition of your own capabilities. It sits between Optimistic (future-focused) and Joyful (present-moment pleasure).

joy-3-joyful.emotionalAlgebra: Joyful is the heart of Joy—pure, present-moment happiness. It sits between Confident (self-directed joy) and Loving (other-directed joy).

joy-4-loving.emotionalAlgebra: Loving sits at the border of Joy and Trust, combining happiness with deep care. It's joy directed toward connection and nurturing others.

trust-1-grateful.emotionalAlgebra: Grateful sits at the border of Trust and Joy, combining security with appreciation. It's the recognition that you've received something valuable.

trust-2-peaceful.emotionalAlgebra: Peaceful is the calm center of Trust—a state of equilibrium and safety. It sits between Grateful (appreciating what is) and Accepted (belonging with others).

trust-3-accepted.emotionalAlgebra: Accepted is Trust expressed through belonging—the security of being seen and included. It sits between Peaceful (inner calm) and Hopeful (trusting the future).

trust-4-hopeful.emotionalAlgebra: Hopeful sits at the border of Trust and Fear, combining faith with uncertainty. It's trust extended toward an unknown but desired future.

fear-1-nervous.emotionalAlgebra: Nervous sits at the border of Fear and Trust, combining caution with vulnerability. It's a mild alert signal that something needs attention.

fear-2-scared.emotionalAlgebra: Scared is the active center of Fear—an immediate response to perceived danger. It sits between Nervous (milder concern) and Anxious (broader worry).

fear-3-anxious.emotionalAlgebra: Anxious is Fear spread across time—worry about future threats. It sits between Scared (immediate fear) and Insecure (fear about self).

fear-4-insecure.emotionalAlgebra: Insecure sits at the border of Fear and Surprise, combining self-doubt with unexpected threats to worth. It's fear turned inward toward identity.

surprise-1-startled.emotionalAlgebra: Startled sits at the border of Surprise and Fear, combining suddenness with alarm. It's the body's immediate orienting response to the unexpected.

surprise-2-confused.emotionalAlgebra: Confused is Surprise meeting uncertainty—your mental map doesn't fit reality. It sits between Startled (physical surprise) and Amazed (positive surprise).

surprise-3-amazed.emotionalAlgebra: Amazed is the positive heart of Surprise—wonder at something exceeding expectations. It sits between Confused (neutral surprise) and Disappointed (negative surprise).

surprise-4-disappointed.emotionalAlgebra: Disappointed sits at the border of Surprise and Sadness, combining unmet expectations with loss. It's surprise that something hoped for didn't materialize.

sad-1-hurt.emotionalAlgebra: Hurt sits at the border of Sadness and Surprise, combining pain with the unexpected wound. It's the sting of emotional injury.

sad-2-depressed.emotionalAlgebra: Depressed is deep Sadness—energy and hope depleted. It sits between Hurt (acute pain) and Lonely (disconnection from others).

sad-3-lonely.emotionalAlgebra: Lonely is Sadness about connection—the pain of feeling unseen or apart. It sits between Depressed (inner emptiness) and Ashamed (self-judgment).

sad-4-ashamed.emotionalAlgebra: Ashamed sits at the border of Sadness and Disgust, combining loss with self-judgment. It's sadness directed at oneself for falling short.

disgust-1-dislike.emotionalAlgebra: Dislike sits at the border of Disgust and Sadness, combining aversion with withdrawal. It's a signal that something doesn't fit your values.

disgust-2-avoidance.emotionalAlgebra: Avoidance is Disgust in action—the impulse to create distance. It sits between Dislike (the judgment) and Awful (intense disgust).

disgust-3-aweful.emotionalAlgebra: Awful is the intense center of Disgust—a visceral rejection of something harmful. It sits between Avoidance (behavioral response) and Disapproval (moral judgment).

disgust-4-disapproval.emotionalAlgebra: Disapproval sits at the border of Disgust and Anger, combining rejection with the energy to confront. It's disgust that wants to change something.

anger-1-aggressive.emotionalAlgebra: Aggressive sits at the border of Anger and Disgust, combining force with rejection. It's anger ready to defend or attack.

anger-2-mad.emotionalAlgebra: Mad is the hot center of Anger—intense displeasure at a violation. It sits between Aggressive (action-ready) and Frustrated (blocked goals).

anger-3-frustrated.emotionalAlgebra: Frustrated is Anger meeting obstacles—the energy to change something that isn't working. It sits between Mad (intense anger) and Critical (analytical anger).

anger-4-critical.emotionalAlgebra: Critical sits at the border of Anger and Anticipation, combining displeasure with vigilance. It's anger channeled into evaluation and improvement.

anticipation-1-excited.emotionalAlgebra: Excited sits at the border of Anticipation and Anger, combining forward energy with intensity. It's anticipation supercharged with enthusiasm.

anticipation-2-eager.emotionalAlgebra: Eager is Anticipation in motion—ready and wanting to engage. It sits between Excited (high energy) and Interested (curious engagement).

anticipation-3-interested.emotionalAlgebra: Interested is the thoughtful heart of Anticipation—attention drawn toward something worth exploring. It sits between Eager (ready to act) and Stressed (overwhelmed by demands).

anticipation-4-stressed.emotionalAlgebra: Stressed sits at the border of Anticipation and Joy, paradoxically combining high demands with goal-directed energy. It's anticipation overloaded.
